sentences.text: Raj Kishore Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 1 December, 2025

1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No. /2025

[@ Slp [Crl.] No.15579/2023]
 Raj Kishore Singh Appellant(s)
 Versus
 The State Of Bihar & Anr. Respondent(s)
 O R D E R
Leave granted.
The appellant has been arrayed as accused No.2 in CC No.695/2021 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The appellant is the father-in-law of respondent No.2 being the complainant.

The High Court has dismissed his petition to quash the order dated 14.06.2022, wherein the Magistrate has found a prima facie case against him, on the premise that the contentions raised in the complaint are a matter for trial.
Learned counsel appearing for the appellant took us through the very complaint made.
Upon perusal of the same, we find absolutely no material to implicate the appellant for the aforementioned offences.
The statements made on oath by the complainant and the witnesses are an improved version of the complaint which, in our considered view, cannot be taken note of.

We are of the view that the decision rendered by this Court in Kahkashan Kausar alias Sonam & Ors.
v. State of Bihar & Ors. reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599, as relied upon by the learned counsel appearing for the appellant would apply to the facts of the present case.

entities.text:
Kahkashan Kausar alias Sonam & Ors.
v. State of Bihar & Ors. reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Perhaps respondent No.2 wants to address her grievance in pursuant to a matrimonial discord by giving this private complaint.
May be that is the reason for her non-appearance, though a Vakalatnama has been filed on her behalf.
Suffice it is to state that continuing the criminal proceedings against the appellant would amount to harassment and a travesty of justice.
Accordingly, the impugned order is set aside and consequently, the proceedings arising out of CC No. 695/2021 stand quashed qua the appellant.
